questions.questionText: When did the Cold War officially end?
questions.hint: Fall of Berlin Wall to USSR collapse.
questions.explanation: The Cold War ended between 1989 (Berlin Wall fall) and 1991 (Soviet Union dissolution).

questions.questionText: What event triggered the War on Terror?
questions.explanation: 9/11 attacks on World Trade Center and Pentagon triggered US-led global War on Terror.

questions.questionText: What was the Gulf War (1990-1991)?

options.text: US-led coalition against Iraqi invasion of Kuwait

questions.explanation: US-led coalition expelled Iraqi forces from Kuwait after Saddam Hussein's invasion.

questions.questionText: What was unipolar moment?

options.text: Period of US dominance after Cold War

questions.explanation: Unipolar moment described US position as sole superpower after Soviet collapse.

questions.questionText: What was the War in Afghanistan (2001-2021)?

options.text: US invasion to remove Taliban and capture Al-Qaeda

questions.explanation: US invaded Afghanistan after 9/11 to remove Taliban government supporting Al-Qaeda.

questions.questionText: What is terrorism?

options.text: Violence targeting civilians for political goals

questions.explanation: Terrorism uses violence against civilians to create fear and achieve political objectives.

questions.questionText: What was the Iraq War (2003-2011)?

options.text: US-led invasion to remove Saddam Hussein

questions.explanation: US and allies invaded Iraq in 2003, claiming Hussein possessed weapons of mass destruction.

questions.questionText: How did 9/11 change global politics?

options.text: Increased security measures, wars in Afghanistan and Iraq, and surveillance states

questions.explanation: 9/11 led to invasive security measures, wars, and fundamental shifts in civil liberties globally.

questions.questionText: What is globalization?

options.text: Increased interconnectedness of economies and cultures worldwide

questions.explanation: Globalization describes increasing economic, cultural, and political interdependence worldwide.

questions.questionText: What is the rise of China in global affairs?

options.text: China's economic and political emergence as major world power

questions.explanation: China's rapid economic growth made it second-largest economy, challenging US global dominance.

questions.questionText: What was the Arab Spring?

options.text: Wave of protests across Middle East and North Africa

questions.explanation: Arab Spring (2010-2012) saw mass protests demanding democracy and economic reform across region.

questions.questionText: What is international terrorism?
questions.explanation: International terrorism involves attacks, planning, or financing across national boundaries.

questions.questionText: What was the 2008 global financial crisis?

options.text: Major worldwide economic recession caused by banking crisis

questions.explanation: 2008 crisis was worst since Great Depression, triggered by US subprime mortgage collapse.

questions.questionText: What is climate change as a global issue?
questions.explanation: Climate change requires international cooperation through agreements like Paris to limit warming.

questions.questionText: Analyze the impact of the War on Terror on civil liberties.

options.text: Increased surveillance and reduced privacy in democratic nations
Had no impact on civil liberties

questions.explanation: Counter-terrorism measures expanded government surveillance, raised Guantánamo issues, challenged human rights.

questions.questionText: Evaluate whether the post-Cold War era is more or less peaceful.

options.text: Reduced major power conflicts but increased regional wars and terrorism

questions.explanation: While major power war declined, regional conflicts, terrorism, and proxy wars persist.

questions.questionText: How has the rise of digital technology affected global politics?

options.text: Created new security threats, misinformation, and cyber warfare

questions.explanation: Digital technology enabled social movements, information warfare, cyberattacks, and new intelligence methods.

questions.questionText: Analyze the challenges to the post-1945 international order.

options.text: Nationalism, great power competition, and multilateralism challenges

questions.explanation: Challenges include great power rivalry, WTO disputes, and questions about UN effectiveness.

questions.questionText: Evaluate the effectiveness of counter-terrorism strategies.

options.text: Mixed results with significant costs to civil liberties and international relations

questions.explanation: Counter-terrorism strategies range from military intervention to intelligence cooperation, with mixed results.

questions.questionText: How has migration changed global politics?

options.text: Created political tensions, demographic shifts, and integration challenges

questions.explanation: Migration patterns reshape demographics, fuel political movements, and challenge national identities.
